description: Router, one in and eight out, with switches — the input reaches an output only while its switch is on

params.text: A switch passes at unity gain; right-click one and type any level from -100% to 100%

inputs.text: The signal offered to all eight switches

outputs.text: Carries the input while its own switch is on, and 0V while that switch is off

notes: a switch slews a little as it changes, to keep the change from popping
every switch starts off, so nothing reaches any output until switches are turned on
menu: Output clipping — Soft/saturated (better for audio) rounds the output off at 12V, Hard/clipped (better for CV) cuts it there and so sums CVs exactly, and None leaves it uncapped
Inverting — Disabled stops a switch inverting at all; By param entry (right-click) allows a negative level to be typed; On second click makes a second click on a switch invert it
Exclusive switching — only one switch may be on at a time, so the input reaches only one output
